claims.statement: Jem Mace beat Tom Allen in ten rounds on May 10, 1870 at Kennersville, Ind. (as printed), and then declared himself heavyweight champion of the world.
claims.excerpt: met in Kennersville, Ind., May 10, 1870, and Mace won in 10 rounds

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in seven rounds in St. Louis on September 23, 1873, to settle the heavyweight championship.
claims.excerpt: They met in St. Louis, September 23, 1873 and Allen, the Englishman, won in seven rounds

claims.statement: After beating McCoole, Tom Allen was recognized by the public as the king of the heavyweights.
claims.excerpt: The public then recognized Allen as the king of heavies.

claims.statement: Joe Goss beat Tom Allen after one hour and fifty-two minutes of fighting, and the championship passed to Goss.
claims.excerpt: Allen fought Joe Goss and after one hour and fifty-two minutes of furious fighting Goss won
